newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 24.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - APRIL 24.

text.p: These are the main headlines reported by Kuku Radio on Wednesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Tallinn mayor Robert Lepiskon has threatened to take Estonian daily Eesti Paevaleht to court because he found a recent editorial insulting.
- Parliament has simplified the procedure of land privatisation for congregations.
- An Estonian fishing boat sank in Latvia's Ventspils port.
